repo:objectstack#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibyUSf2nKJWW6qBemSU

Claim amendment 1 to 7217235557. It records what PR #37933 (head `58771103`) touches outside the first surface, by its report 7220504764.
Route change: the server no longer overrides `manifest.name` on GET /packages. The console reads the package name from the translation bundle it is already served (`useObjectLabel().packageName`), because the edit dialog pre-fills from the list row and an override in place would save the translated name back. The PR's Acceptance notes give the reason. L2 may send it back to the first route.
File surface adds, each forced by a gate or the build:
- `packages/lint/src/i18n-walk.ts` and `packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-coverage.ts` with their tests (`check:i18n-walk-parity`)
- `scripts/fixtures/i18n-walk-parity/**`
- the `examples/*/src/**/translations/**` packs, which add the package name (`check:i18n-coverage` ratchet)
- `packages/spec/src/kernel/manifest.zod.ts` and `packages/spec/src/kernel/address-grammar.ts`
- `packages/runtime/src/package-display-name-disabled.test.ts` (the disabled-package pin)
- `ui/packages/i18n/src/**` (useObjectLabel, spec-translations, studio namespace)
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/**`
- `content/docs/references/**` (generated)
Changesets add `@objectstack/lint` and `@objectstack/cli` as minor. NOT `skills/**`, NOT `docs/adr/**`, NOT the hotcrm repo, all unchanged.
Owed follow-ups (carded by the seat after L2): skills/objectstack-i18n and the translations docs teach the `packages` group; `os validate` checks `packages` keys against the known manifest ids.
Everything else in the claim is unchanged.
